Exam Date & Time: 12-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  Low Power VLSI Design [ECE-4063]  
Marks: 50                                                                                 Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           The chip size of a CPU is 10mm*10mm with a clock frequency of 350 Mhz operating at  
  5V. The length of the clock routing is estimated to be twice of the circumference of the  
  chip. Assume that the clock signals routed on a metal layer with a width of 1.5 micro    (4)  
  A)        metre and parasitic capacitance of metal layer is 1Ff/ micro meter. Estimate the power  
  dissipation of the clocked signal.  
  
  B)       Calculate the switching frequency for a half adder circuit (Sum & Carry) assume the  
  time period is 10ns for each bit input.                                                     (3)  
  
  C)       Describe why low power consumption is essential in VLSI design                              (3)  
2)            Determine the static signal probability for 3 Bit Binary to Gray code converter using  
  basic gates  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)       Find the activity factor for the function  
  F=A XOR B XOR C in basic gates. Assume P(A)= P(B)= P(C)= 0.5                                (3)  
  
  C)       Define gate level power analysis using transition density                                   (3)  
3)            Given the switching function F(A,B,C)=(A+BC+B'C')'. Assume that all inputs toggle  
  with a probability of 0.5. Calculate the activity factor for all intermediate outputs and  
  (4)

  A)  
  B)       Consider the counter that counts in the following sequence such as 0,7,1,6,5 or 0,1,3,2,4.  
  Determine which sequence has minimum power dissipation.                                    (3)  
  
  C)       Calculate signal entropy for the function F=AB+C for all the input, output and  
  intermediate nodes.                                                                         (3)  
  
4)            Represent F=AB+BC+CA in reduced ordered binary decision diagram. Using Thornton  
  and Nair's top down approach algorithm, compute the output probability for the  
  ROBDD.                                                                          (4)  
  A)  
  B)       Consider the state machine encoding for a two bit odd/ even counter. If control signal  
  input is 0, it behaves as an odd counter else it behaves as even counter. Compute the       (3)  
  number of transitions and calculate E(M).  
  
  C)       Explain state machine coding and transition analysis coding.                                (3)
